Callout.Name: Assault on an Officer
Callout.Message: Officer assaulted during a stop, suspect restrained by a member of the public.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect held on the ground, officer with a facial injury.

Script.Line: I never touched him. Ask the man in the van, he pulled me off.
You are hurting my arm. It was already like that before you got here.
He went for me first. That is the whole of it. That is what happened.

Lines.Approach: A member of the public has him on the ground. The officer took one to the face.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
